summary: Quiet unsigned kerb near the junction; homes 13-15 m on its side, cars park nearby.

best_section.where: Seventh Avenue south kerb, down the slope from the junction, below the garage

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes 13 m to 15 m from this section on its own side, with a garage at 10 m; more homes across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street; cars are parked at the kerb at the lower end, so there is room to stop.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, light local traffic.
drivers.convention: No signs on this kerb; a few cars park along the lower end and the junction side.

sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the north side, shading the midday and morning sun.
